interacoes.en: No formal drug interaction studies have been performed with calcitonin salmon nasal spray. Concomitant use of calcitonin salmon and lithium may lead to a reduction in plasma lithium concentrations due to increased urinary clearance of lithium. The dose of lithium may require adjustment. interacoes.pt: Nenhum estudo formal de interação medicamentosa foi realizado com spray nasal de calcitonina para salmão.
